The City of Kingston Police can be reached by calling 911 for emergencies or by calling 613-549-4660 to report a non-emergency. For deaf, hard of hearing, or speech-impaired persons only, call 613-549-8792.

For more information please visit the City of Kingston Police website at www.kingstonpolice.ca
